intent: Modify head pitch and eye visibility while preserving character identities and limited palette

gerard.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise portrait pose correction.
Edit target: supplied 4x2 commentator atlas. Preserve SAME identity, clothes, broad flat drawn shapes, limited-color style, headset and navy rail. EXACTLY four equal columns and two equal rows. Same scale, head and forearms fully inside each cell, aligned baseline. Top row mouths closed, bottom row corresponding same poses with mouths open speaking. No text, grid, labels or watermark.
CRITICAL FIX: the reference heads are bent MUCH too far down and the eyes have disappeared. RAISE THE CHIN to a nearly upright face, head pitch only 8-12 degrees DOWN, shoulders mostly frontal, head yaw at most 5-8 degrees. The viewer MUST clearly see BOTH COMPLETE OPEN EYES in every cell: ivory sclera visible on both sides of charcoal pupils, clear separate lower eyelids, brows above the eyes with enough separation. Facial features must read at a 192x128 portrait display. No hidden eyelids, black slits, closed eyes, large visible top of skull, bowed head or chin pressed to chest. Draw the eye whites as decisive simple light shapes, not tiny glints.
Gaze is toward the arena a little BELOW and INWARD, directed primarily by pupils, not a dramatic head turn. These two commentators sit above the opposite edges of ONE same board and watch their own near half toward the middle. Not looking directly at camera, not looking across the whole screen at the other man. Natural restrained human expressions, not oversized cartoon grins or anime eyes.
No photo texture, no gradients, no dither, no extra fine wrinkles. Palette: dark navy, flat pastel blues, three warm skin tones, ivory, silver gray; limited yellow/red/green accents. Solid #091423 background.
CHARACTER: GERARD, left commentator. Rugged receding dark hair, short salt-and-pepper beard, pastel BLUE Hawaiian shirt with broad simple YELLOW LEMONS and RED FLOWERS, navy undershirt. His open eyes glance slightly DOWN and toward the VIEWER'S RIGHT, around 10 degrees inward, watching the left-center of the board below. Face stays nearly frontal, both cheeks similarly visible. Four poses: neutral attentive watching; enthusiastic one hand explaining; worried hand on headphone; tense hands gripping rail. Eyes readable in ALL poses.

eyeReadabilityPass.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / final eye readability pass.
Edit target: this exact GERARD 4x2 sprite atlas. Keep identity, face proportions, near-upright head, body, all eight poses, shirt, headset, mouth poses, background, palette style, framing, rail, EVERYTHING unchanged except the eyes and eyebrows.
ONLY FIX: the thick angry eyebrows still press onto the eyelids and turn the eyes into dark slits at 192x128 per cell. Make his expression attentive rather than a constant angry scowl: raise each eyebrow a little and separate it visibly from the upper eyelid. Draw TWO CLEAR OPEN HUMAN EYES in every cell, each with a decisive IVORY WHITE sclera and one small charcoal pupil. The eye whites must be flat light ivory, not blue-gray or skin-colored, and be tall enough to survive reduction to 2-3 logical pixels of visible white. Natural realistic eye proportions, not oversized, not anime, no googly eyes. Both eyes fully readable, not obscured by brows. Keep rugged forehead, beard and his ordinary gruff identity.
Pupils look slightly DOWN and toward VIEWER'S RIGHT, toward his own side of a game board below center, NOT toward the far right edge, NOT looking directly at camera. Do this with eyes, not by bowing the head or turning it sideways. Chin stays nearly level, only about 10 degrees down.
Keep exact FOUR equally sized columns and TWO rows: top mouths closed; bottom matching open-speaking mouths. Do not change pose alignment, hand gestures, body size or design. Pastel blue Hawaiian shirt, yellow lemons, red flowers, dark headset. Flat drawn limited-color planes, no gradients or photograph detail, no extra wrinkles, no new objects, no text, no watermark.
